strings.Calzado acuático cerrado, bañador, agua,: Closed aquatic shoes, swimsuit, water, towel and dry clothes. Do not use loose objects.
strings.No recomendable con miedo fuerte al agua: Not recommended with a strong fear of water, joint injuries, low mobility or refusal to follow instructions.
strings.Oleaje, profundidad, visibilidad del fon: Waves, depth, bottom visibility, water exit, wind, fatigue or reckless behavior.
strings.Progresion por roca y agua con lectura c: Progression through rock and water with constant reading of the sea. Jumps, if they exist, are optional and only with verified depth.
strings.Resbalones, golpes, hipotermia, caídas,: Slips, blows, hypothermia, falls, cuts, fear of water and sea changes.
strings.Con un centro especializado colaborador: With a partner specialist centre qualified in the discipline.
